decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork, so it costs little to keep while its uncertain prospects are still resolving, though its mere mention on the website suggests modest commitment.

The energy management system for water facilities fits the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy recovery, so it is a valuable growth option still under uncertainty that can be carried cheaply on existing IT modules.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and a dedicated page, which signals that value is being realized and the firm is committing further, so dropping it is unlikely.
